title: Ideal Poisson--Voronoi tessellations for Finsler metrics on symmetric spaces
summary: Ideal Poisson--Voronoi tessellations are random tessellations that arise as limits of Voronoi diagrams for Poisson point processes as their intensity tends to zero. For the Riemannian metric on a symmetric space of higher rank, Frączyk, Mellick, and Wilkens (arXiv:2307.01194) proved that the corresponding ideal Poisson--Voronoi tessellation is almost surely completely connected, with an unbounded side between any two cells. This contrasts sharply with the geometry of ideal Poisson--Voronoi tessellations in hyperbolic spaces studied by D'Achille, Curien, Enriquez, Lyons, and Ünel…
